versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "Career Reinvention": practical guidance for white-collar workers displaced by AI.
- Interactive skills audit helps users identify transferable strengths and personal preferences.
- Realistic, research-backed career paths in trades, healthcare, AI-adjacent, education, and local service fields, with honest pay and timeline data.
- Clear evaluation framework: income floor, training cost/time, job demand, and fit.
- Step-by-step transition plan to avoid financial pitfalls while changing careers.
